stance.label: US pullback, Taiwan bear: stick to the plan

headline: Core PCE at 3.3% locks in a hike; US stocks recover from an intraday rout; Taiwan futures +274 overnight
summary: US stocks plunged intraday but cut losses by the close, and the equal-weight index even rose: the selling was in chips, not a broad retreat. Core PCE beat forecasts, so a December hike looks all but certain. Section 301 tariffs keep Taiwan under its 15% cap, milder than the verbal threats. In Taiwan, watch whether foreign investors stop selling. Keep regular investing on plan.

overview.lead: Last night US stocks dropped hard and then recovered: chips dragged the open, but by the close only tech was slightly down and the market held.
points: The Dow fell over 1,100 points intraday, then closed up 0.33%.
The S&P 500 fell 0.25% and the Nasdaq 0.62%, far above the lows.
The equal-weight S&P 500 (RSP) rose 0.83%: money rotated rather than left.
Nvidia (NVDA) fell 8% intraday and closed down 3.91% on AI profit doubts.
Taiwan night futures rose 274 points, so Taiwan stocks may steady today.

focus.lead: Tech and Taiwan are still under the most pressure. QQQ is only 4.1% from tier 4, the one to watch today.
points: QQQ tier 4 is 607.73, 4.1% away.
SPY fell only 0.29%, 7.6% from tier 3; the broad market is steadiest.
Allianz Taiwan Technology (TW000T3604Y3) NAV fell 5.25% on 11/25, nearly 40% off its high.
Cathay Taiwan High Dividend (TW000T3786A8) NAV fell 4.3% on 11/25; the two Taiwan funds' top ten overlap about 27%.
AB International Technology (LU0060230025) and Neuberger Berman Taiwan Japan (TW000T5011A9) NAVs are only through 11/24 and miss the 11/25 drop.

position.lead: No new tier triggered last night under the framework; the nearest is still QQQ tier 4.
points: QQQ has used 45% of its reserve; tier 4 is 4.1% away.
SPY has used 25% of its reserve; tier 3 is 7.6% away.
Fidelity Japan Value (LU0997587083) tier 5 is 8.5% away (11/25 NAV).
AB Select US Equity (LU0683600562) tier 3 is 8.3% away (11/24 NAV).
Allianz Taiwan Technology, Cathay Taiwan High Dividend and AB International Technology have used all tiers.

macro.lead: Inflation has not cooled and a hike is nearly certain, yet bonds rallied: the market is betting growth slows after the hike.
points: Core PCE rose 3.3% from a year earlier, above the 3.2% forecast.
Headline PCE rose 3.8%, the highest since 2023.
CME futures price about a 98% chance of a December 25 bp hike.
The 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.85%; long-bond ETF TLT rose 0.92%.
The high-yield spread is 3.72% (11/24), up 0.42 points in a month, still far from the alarm line.

sentiment.lead: Fear is still high and short-term volatility is above longer-term volatility, so the market is not at ease yet.
points: VIX closed at 28.29, in its 98th percentile for the year.
The VIX term structure is inverted (short-term/3-month 1.076), a bottoming signal.
The CNN Fear & Greed index is 15.2, extreme fear.
6 of 11 sectors are above their 200-day lines; breadth has not collapsed.

sectors.lead: Chips and tech fell while other sectors rose: money moved from AI to old-economy stocks.
points: The semiconductor ETF (SMH) fell 1.01% and is down 24% in a month.
Tech fell 0.83%; software also slipped 0.35%.
Materials rose 2.07%, the strongest sector.
Industrials, communications and financials rose about 0.7% to 0.9%.

taiwan.lead: Taiwan opens on better footing than yesterday: the chip index barely fell, the TSMC ADR lost under 2% and night futures rose, but foreign short futures have not eased.
points: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 0.65%, much less than the night before.
The TSMC ADR (TSM) fell 1.96%; our calculated premium is about 4.6%.
Taiwan night futures rose 274 points to 38,397.
Foreign net short TAIEX futures stand at 105,709 contracts, still high.
Foreign investors have sold Taiwan stocks 8 days in a row, NT$123.7B on 11/25.
USD/TWD is 32.849 (11/24): the Taiwan dollar is weak but not crashing.

watch.lead: Two things decide whether Taiwan stops bleeding: when foreign selling ends, and how Treasuries move after the December hike.
points: US markets close 11/26 for Thanksgiving, so Taiwan gets no new US lead today.
US stocks close early on 11/27, with thin volume.
12/4 US November jobs report (Taipei 21:30).
FOMC decision early 12/10; November CPI that evening.
Section 301 tariffs take effect in January at the earliest; Taiwan's rate details await the notice.

regime.lead: By the rules, US stocks are still in a pullback and Taiwan is still a bear market with rising risk; last night's recovery changed neither call and made nothing worse.
points: Trend: the S&P 500 is 2.3% below its rising 200-day line for 7 days; the line has not flattened.
Systemic lights: 1 on for the US (below the 200-day line), 2 for Taiwan.
Credit, the economy and financial conditions are fine; the high-yield spread is 3.72%, far from 5%.
Bottoming signals: 2 on for the US, term inversion and extreme fear; oversold and VIX panic are not on.
Past declines to this level usually stopped as corrections: since 1929 only 19 of 102 went past −20%.
Of the 36 equally fast cases near the 200-day line, only 4 went past −20%.
Flip: 5 S&P 500 closes below 7,352 with a flat line turns the call to weak.
Below 6,255 is a bear market; 3+ risk lights means it may be turning bearish.

news.title: Dow recovers from a 1,000+ point intraday drop to close up 0.33%; S&P 500 −0.25%, Nasdaq −0.62%
news.read: Dip buyers held the market; losses were in chips and AI. By the rules SPY is still in a pullback.

news.title: October core PCE up 3.3%, above forecasts; December hike odds about 98%
news.read: The hike is largely priced in and yields fell; richly valued tech remains under the most pressure.

news.title: US proposes Section 301 overcapacity tariffs on 14 economies; Taiwan and Japan keep the 15% cap
news.read: Taiwan's rate stays within the existing deal and starts in January at the earliest, milder than the chip-tariff talk, removing some uncertainty for Taiwan and Japan.

news.title: Nvidia falls 8% intraday and closes down about 4% on AI profit and overinvestment worries
news.read: Nvidia is a big weight in QQQ and both AB funds; AI sentiment has not recovered.

news.title: TSMC ADR falls 1.96% to US$342.34; Taiwan night futures up 274 points
news.read: The ADR fell less than Taiwan did yesterday and night futures rose, so Taiwan may steady today.

news.title: Foreign investors sell NT$123.7B, the 7th-largest ever, for an 8th straight day
news.read: Until foreigners turn buyers, any Taiwan rebound deserves a discount.
